description: Golden dataset: labeled buggy snippets used to measure the Glitch Investigator's detection accuracy (Module 5 reliability testing). Each case has an id, a buggy code snippet, and the expected knowledge-base pattern id. Several are the real bugs from the original glitchy guessing game.

cases.note: The original game's flagship bug: secret regenerated every rerun.
cases.code:
import streamlit as st
import random
secret = random.randint(1, 100)
guess = st.number_input('Guess')
if st.button('Submit'):
    st.write('You guessed', guess, 'secret was', secret)

cases.note: The original game cast the secret to str on even attempts.
The original game pointed the hints the wrong way.
